purpose: Close the deterministic workshop loop between rough spatial intent and reusable sticker construction: bind every sketch part to an exact existing 3D sticker, compile or save an ordinary immutable assembly, compare its direct target-frame state back to the exact sketch, propose only uniquely grounded placement repairs, and save those repairs as a new immutable assembly version without inventing source geometry, size, fit, physics, or aesthetics.

properties.operation: inspect-construction-loop, validate-sticker-build, compile-sticker-build, save-sticker-build, compare-sticker-assembly, propose-sticker-repair, or save-sticker-repair
properties.database: local UC sticker SQLite registry; relative paths must stay in creations/.axm-build or may be outside the machine body
properties.sketch: exact axm.design-sketch/v0.1 body from Design Workshop
properties.plan: axm.design-sticker-build/v0.1 body binding every sketch part once to an exact 3D sticker pin plus explicit overrides/placement
properties.assembly: exact immutable sticker pin for a saved 3D assembly
properties.name: new assembly display name
properties.origin: author/license/source provenance; workshop lineage is appended rather than replacing caller source
properties.socket: optional attachment socket for a newly built assembly
properties.anchor: optional rigid attachment frame for a newly built assembly

contains: explicit exact source sticker pins for every sketch part
ordinary axm.sticker/v1 assembly children using sketch frames as declared target socket frames
placement-only residuals for position, orientation and frame-derived workshop gauges
separate HOLD for actual source mesh dimensions
bounded set-target-frame repair actions only when uniquely grounded
new immutable repaired assembly version plus post-repair structural verification

relationships: uses Design Workshop sketch intent without changing the verified sketch/gauge contract
uses UC's embedded sticker core and ordinary assembly v1 rather than requiring external Sticker Fabric at runtime
can consume ordinary multiplied sticker wrappers because multiplication outputs normal exact-pinned sticker definitions
keeps source-sticker selection explicit instead of inferring a part identity from a rough blockout shape

implementation.source: src/axm_uc/design_workshop_construction.py via src/axm_uc/__init__.py registration; matching JSON operations are also exposed through src/axm_uc/sticker_create.py

limitations: v0.1 requires one exact 3D sticker binding for every sketch part
the sketch part frame becomes a target socket frame; no geometric-center or dimension correspondence is inferred
saved assembly recipes expose placement state but not actual source mesh dimensions, so size evidence stays HOLD
automatic repair changes only direct child target frames; missing/extra parts and size/geometry/material/aesthetic changes stay unresolved
parameterized source assemblies are rejected by repair v0.1 rather than silently invalidating their defaults
repair rebases explicit rigid motion samples when the target frame moves but makes no animation-quality claim

truth.basis: Exact sketch digests, sticker pins, assembly pins, structural residuals and repair receipts are revalidated; unavailable mesh-size evidence remains HOLD.

agency.basis: The caller chooses every source sticker binding, override, placement, output identity/version/provenance and whether a proposed repair is saved.

continuity.basis: Build, compare and repair receipts bind the exact sketch, source pins, source assembly and new immutable assembly version without rewriting prior versions.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Structural mismatches, unknown pins, missing/extra parts, parameterized repair ambiguity and unobserved dimensions hold or fail closed instead of being guessed through.
